purpose: Reads and writes the Windows startup registry entry (HKCU Run key) to control whether the app launches at login.
invariants: GetStartupEnabled returns true only if the registry value matches the current exe path (portable mode) or the legacy %APPDATA% path
Legacy startup entries pointing at the old %APPDATA% copy are automatically migrated to CurrentExePath on first read
gotchas: If the registry value exists but points at neither CurrentExePath nor LegacyInstalledExePath, GetStartupEnabled returns false and logs a warning — this can happen if the user moved the exe manually
SetStartupEnabled throws InvalidOperationException if the registry key cannot be opened/created; callers must handle this
